newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London quiet, Autobacs features.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London quiet, Autobacs features.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading in London on Monday were mixed in very quiet trade ahead of the U.S. FOMC rate meeting on Tuesday and as major European bourses were closed for public holidays.
The Nikkei/Ise 50 index was up 4.92 points at 1,595.60 by 1429 GMT.
The main feature of the day was car parts maker Autobacs Seven Co Ltd, which announced a decision to buy back up to 3.8 million shares.
"It has created quite an extreme reaction in the stock," a dealer said.
Autobacs rose to a high of 8,900 yen in London but later eased to be up 152 yen at 8,725. The shares closed at 8,250 in Tokyo.
"With Europe off and the FOMC meeting tomorrow, there are two very good reasons to sit on the fence," one dealer said.
"We have seen some derivative related sellers and some people picking up the blue-chips...but nothing spectacular," he added.
The Nikkei 225 share average closed at a year high in Tokyo to be up 165.02 points at 20,489.75, as blue-chips recovered on a strong yen.
The mood remained cautious, however, ahead of a possible U.S. rate rise after the FOMC meeting on Tuesday and dealers in London expected the Nikkei to drift until the decision was known.
"Topix hit a resistance level today and then bounced off," one said. "I expect the Nikkei will drift."
